integrity: The rank formula is proved symbolically by alternating block elimination and symplectic subspace counts; finite exhaustive examples are corroborative. Published rank-to-character conversion is credited; independence is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact rank formula covers every finite field and a,b,c>=2. Character-degree counts are asserted for odd q only. Finite checks do not prove the universal formula. The result does not imply a corresponding rank histogram for arbitrary graph joins; equivalent historic symplectic enumeration remains a literature risk.
title: Complete alternating-rank spectra and graphical-group character degrees for complete tripartite graphs
